purpose: Mechanical friction sensitivity only; it is not an expected-return model.
latency_assumption_note: A deliberately pessimistic sensitivity grid, not an observed rate. It maps 1/3/5/10/30/60 seconds to 50/150/250/500/1500/3000 bps of adverse movement.
network_cost_note: Scenario only: one Solana signature (5,000 lamports) plus a 300,000-CU transaction at Raydium high tier (15,000 micro-lamports/CU), priced at $95.09109655/SOL from final Jupiter price snapshot. Actual instructions, signatures and priority fees must be quoted immediately before execution.
jito_tip_note: 0, final-refresh p75, p95 and p99 tip equivalents at the snapshot. A Jito bundle is not assumed to be used for every swap. Current raw tip percentiles were 0.000006 SOL (p75), 0.0000591232 SOL (p95), and 0.00082832 SOL (p99).
pool_fee_note: 125 bps is the official Pump canonical-pool fee at 0-420 SOL market cap. 30 bps is the official Pump non-canonical fee. Fee schedules vary by pool and market-cap tier and must be refreshed from the actual route.
